title: Layering
description: An earlier exercise when I started diving into sound design, this was aimed to understand the three main types of layering: Cohesive, Complimentary, and Contrasting. These samples were done within Phaseplant using various oscillators or samples to create pads. While not overly flashy, understanding the methodology behind dissecting sounds can be applied to any instrument, part, or track.
